scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @travel-blocks/api & npm run dev -w @travel-blocks/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:mcp
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @travel-blocks/domain && npm run test -w @travel-blocks/ai
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @travel-blocks/shared && npm run build -w @travel-blocks/domain && npm run build -w @travel-blocks/ai
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @travel-blocks/api && npm run build -w @travel-blocks/mcp && npm run build -w @travel-blocks/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:apps
